in_sanskrit.name: Rijvan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus that grows in the water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rijvan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rijvan is a Hindu name that means 'Lotus that grows in the water'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rij' which means 'lotus' and 'van' which means 'growing'. It symbolizes the ability to thrive in difficult conditions, just like the lotus that blooms in water.
